title: A/R Collection: Cancel on the switch prompt leaves the report as it was
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations: your current location and your other location.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with overdue invoices at your current location and one, invoice A, at your other location; more than 20 other customers have overdue invoices.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with "Past due: 1-30 days" ticked, the "Amount" header clicked once, customer A's group expanded and the page scrolled so invoice A is in the middle of the screen.
  • Make sure you have noted which rows are at the top and bottom of the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Copy the page address.
  2. Click invoice A's number.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Compare the page address with the copied one.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The address is copied.

Step 2:

  • The "Switch location?" dialog opens.

Step 3:

  • The dialog closes.
  • No message pops up.
  • You stay on the report exactly where you were: the same Past due filter, the Amount sort, customer A's group still expanded and the same rows at the top and bottom of the screen (the same scroll position).

Step 4:

  • The address is the same.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R5: “"Cancel" or the × closes the prompt; the user stays on the report exactly where they were: same page address, filters, sort, expanded groups and scroll position.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Click an invoice at another enrolled location | Title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" | Dialog on the report; "Switch location" switches and opens, "Cancel" stays”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §6 Phase 1, frontend: “'stay' cancel closes the dialog with no toast/no push (S7-R5)”

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD and tech plan quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-cancel-stays-on-the-report.png: figure "Cancel stays on the report" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"

The design's own words:

  • "Same filters, open groups and scroll position. S7-R5, S7-E1." (caption of "Cancel stays on the report")

Difference from the PRD (DD-01), closed: PRD version 5 said buttons "Switch location" and "Cancel" (S7-R3), title "Switch location?"; the design shows buttons "Cancel" (left, grey) then "Switch Location" (right, blue, capital L), and a close "×" at the top right of the dialog; caption: "Switch Location opens it there.". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 11): the existing prompt keeps "Cancel" on the left, "Switch location" (small l) on the right and a close × at the top right, and the × closes it like Cancel; the capital L the picture and the current build show is a build bug to fix. PRD version 9 (S7-R3, S7-R5) now says so, and this case follows PRD version 9.
